questions.question:
The following pie charts represent the distribution of candidates who were enrolled for a competitive examination, and the candidates (out of those enrolled) who passed the exam from five different institutes P,Q, R, S and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a0653024c0126caa48bd0d9f462d2c44d8a340c17b19ad6d84aa5c62a83f37b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80b0d57e4a919cfa47615b346b8a514df138a057671e3266b8379f45535b6ea2.png] 

What is the ratio of the total number of candidates enrolled in institutes Q, R and S together, to the number of candidates passed from the institutes Q, R and S together?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of candidates enrolled in institutes Q, R and S together = (30% + 12% + 18%) of 7500

⇒ 60% of 7500

⇒ 4500

The total number of candidates passed from the institutes Q, R and S together = (24% + 18% + 24%) of 4000

⇒ 66% of 4000

⇒ 2640

Required ratio = 4500 : 2640

⇒ 225 : 132

⇒ 75 : 44

**⇒ Required ratio is 75 : 44**

questions.question: Radha saves 25% of her income. If her expenditure increases by 20% and her income increases by 29%, then her savings increase by;
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Savings to Expenditure = 25% : (100% − 25%) = 25 : 75 = 1 : 3

Income change is the weighted average of Savings change and Expenditure change.

Let the percentage increase in savings be x%.

⇒ (1 × x + 3 × 20) ÷ (1 + 3) = 29

⇒ x + 60 = 116 ⇒ x = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Initial
 
 Income = 100
 
 
 Exp = 75
 
 
 Sav = 25

 Final
 
 New Income = 129 (+29%)

 
 New Exp = 90 (+20%)

 
 New Sav = 39

 
• 
 +56%

**Given:**

Savings = 25% of Income

Increase in Expenditure = 20%

Increase in Income = 29%

**Calculations:**

Let the initial income of Radha be 100.

⇒ Initial Savings = 25% of 100 = 25

⇒ Initial Expenditure = Income − Savings = 100 − 25 = 75

Her income increases by 29%.

⇒ New Income = 100 + 29 = 129

Her expenditure increases by 20%.

⇒ New Expenditure = 75 + (20% of 75) = 75 + 15 = 90

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure

⇒ New Savings = 129 − 90 = 39

Increase in Savings = New Savings − Initial Savings

⇒ Increase in Savings = 39 − 25 = 14

Percentage increase in Savings = (Increase ÷ Initial Savings) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (14 ÷ 25) × 100 = 14 × 4 = 56%

**∴ The correct answer is 56%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings Relationship

Income = Expenditure + Savings. Any change in Income will be directly reflected as a proportional change in both Expenditure and Savings.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = (Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value × 100. It is used to calculate the relative increase or decrease in a quantity over time.

Weighted Average Method

When a base quantity is divided into two parts, the overall percentage change is the weighted average of the percentage changes of the parts: Overall % = (Ratio₁ × %₁ + Ratio₂ × %₂) ÷ (Ratio₁ + Ratio₂).

questions.question: Surbhi sold an article for Rs. 176 after giving 12% discount on its marked price. Had she not given any discount; she would have earned a profit of 25%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs. 176

Discount = 12%

Gain = 25%

**Formula used:**

Marked price = Selling price/(100 – D%)

Cost price : Marked price = (100 – discount%) : (100 + profit%)

**Calculation:**

Marked price = 176/[(100 – 12)/100]

⇒ Rs. 200

According to question

New discount = 0%

Cost price : 200 = (100 – 0) : (100 + 25)

⇒ 200 × 100/125

⇒ Rs. 160

**∴ Cost price of the article is 160 **

 AD/AB = DE/BC

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers A and B is 5 : 8. If 5 is added to each of A and B, then the ratio of A and B becomes 2 : 3. The sum of A and B is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of two numbers = 5 : 8

If 5 is added to each of A and B, the ratio of A and B = 2 : 3

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be 5x and 8x respectively

When 5 is added to each number,

⇒ (5x + 5)/(8x + 5) = 2/3

⇒ (15x + 15) = (16x + 10)

⇒ x = 5

Now the sum of A and B = (5 × 5 + 8 × 5)

⇒ (25 + 40)

⇒ 65

**∴ The sum of A and B is 65**

questions.question: If length of a rectangle is increased to its three times and breadth is decreased to its half, then the ratio of the area of given rectangle to the area of new rectangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of a rectangle is increased to its three times 

Breadth is decreased to its half

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Let,

Original length = 1

Original breadth = 1

So,

New length = 3

New breadth = 1/2

Area of the rectangle = 1 × 1 = 1

New area of the rectangle = 3 × 1/2 = 3/2

Required ratio = 1 : 3/2 = 2 : 3

**∴ The ratio of the area of given rectangle to the area of new rectangle is 2 : 3**

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, AB : AC = 5 : 2, BC = 9 cm. BA is produced to D, and the bisector of the Angle CAD meets BC produced at E. What is the length (in cm) of CE?
questions.solution:

AB : AC = 5 : 2

BC = 9 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b15ba317fd6738af3f3fda1b817eafaf93ffb7cf0d4e7ba9ee71f2ba54e6481.png] 

By external angel bisector theorem,

AB/AC = BE/CE

questions.question: If 2cos²θ = 3sinθ, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (sec²θ - tan²θ + cos²θ) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2cos2θ = 3sinθ

**Formula used:**

Sec²θ – tan²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

2cos2θ = 3sinθ

⇒ 2(1 – sin²θ) = 3sinθ

⇒ 2 – 2sin²θ = 3sinθ

⇒ 2sin²θ + 3sinθ – 2 = 0

⇒ 2sin²θ + 4sinθ – sinθ – 2 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ(sinθ + 2) – (sinθ + 2) = 0

⇒ (sinθ + 2) (2sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ (sinθ + 2) = 0 or (2sinθ – 1) = 0

∴ sinθ = 1over2 and sinθ = -2 

⇒ sinθ = sin30° ⇒ sinθ = -2 (Not possible)

⇒ θ = 30° 

(sec2θ - tan2θ + cos2θ)

⇒ 1 + cos²θ = 1 + cos²30° 

⇒ 1 + ({sqrt3over2})² = 1 + 3over4 = 7over4

**∴ The value of (sec2θ - tan2θ + cos2θ) is 7over4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** As 0° 

So, take θ = 30° or 45° or 60° 

2cos2θ = 3sinθ

⇒ 2cos²30° = 3sin30° 

⇒ 2 × ({sqrt3over2})² = 3 × 1over2

⇒ 3over2 = 3over2

Here, θ = 30° satisfies 2cos2θ = 3sinθ

Put θ = 30°

(sec2θ - tan2θ + cos2θ)

⇒ 1 + cos2θ [ ∵ sec2θ - tan2θ = 1]

⇒ 1 + cos2θ = 1 + cos230° 

⇒ 1 + ({sqrt3over2})² = 1 + 3over4 = 7over4 

∴ The value of (sec2θ - tan2θ + cos2θ) is 7over4.

questions.question: The rate of simple interest for first two years is 8% p.a., for the next 4 years, it is 10% p.a. and for the period beyond 6 years, it is 12% p.a. If a person gets Rs. 18358.60 as simple interest after 9 years, then how much money (in Rs.) did he invest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total interest after 9 years = Rs. 18358.60

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be P

For the first 2 years

SI = P × 8 × 2/100

⇒ 4P/25

For the next 4 years

SI = P × 4 × 10/100

⇒ 2P/5

For the next 3 years

SI = P × 3 × 12/100

⇒ 9P/25

Total interest in 9 years = Rs. 18358.60

⇒ (4P/25 + 2P/5 + 9P/25) = 18358.60

⇒ 23P/25 = 18358.60

⇒ P = 19955

**∴ The amount invested is Rs. 19955**

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, AD is a diameter and AC is a chord. Point B is on AC such that OB = 7 cm and ∠OBA= 60°. If ∠DOC = 60°, then what is the length of BC (in cm)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD is a diameter

OB = 7 cm

∠OBA= 60° and ∠DOC = 60° 

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3924c843ed1d88d06d740c4b352ce6caf3e724ece51a95e35ec1630698316f.png] **

∠ACD = 90° (inscribed angle by diameter)

In ΔOCD, OC = OD = Radius and ∠DOC = 60°

⇒ ΔOCD is an isosceles triangle

⇒ ∠OCD = ∠ODC = (180° - 60°)/2 = 60°

∠ACO = ∠BCO = ​∠ACD - ∠OCD = 90° - 60° = 30° 

∠OBA = ∠BOC + ∠BCO ----(External Angle)

⇒ ∠BOC = 60° - 30° = 30° 

In ΔOBC

∠BOC = ∠BCO = 30° 

⇒ OB = BC 

⇒ BC = 7cm

∴ The length of BC is 7 cm.

questions.question: In a class of 90 students 60% are girls and remaining are boys. Average marks of boys are 63 and that of girls are 70. What are the average marks of the whole class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students of class = 90

**Calculation:**

Number of girls in a class = 90 × 3/5 = 54

Number of boys in a class = 90 – 54 = 36

According to question

Average marks of boys = 63 × 36 = 2268

Average marks of girls = 70 × 54 = 3780

Total marks of boys and girls = (2268 + 3780)

⇒ 6048

Average marks of whole class = (6048/90)

⇒ 67.2

**∴ The average marks of the whole class is 67.2**

questions.question: If x - (1)/(x) = 5, x ne 0, then what is the value of (x⁶ - 5x³ - 1)/(x⁶ + 7x³ - 1) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x - (1)/(x) = 5, x ne 0, 

**Formula used:**

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

**Calculation:**

x – 1/x = 5

⇒ x3 – (1/x)3 – 3 × x × 1/x(x – 1/x) = 125

⇒ x3 – 1/x3 – 15 = 125

⇒ x3 – 1/x3 = 140

Now, according to the question

 (x⁶ - 5x³ - 1)/(x⁶ + 7x³ - 1)

⇒ (x³ – 1/x³ – 5)/(x³ – 1/x³ + 7) 

⇒ (140 – 5)/(140 + 7)

⇒ 135/147

⇒ 45/49

**∴ The value of (x⁶ - 5x³ - 1)/(x⁶ + 7x³ - 1) is 45/49**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Formula used:

x - 1/x = k

x³ - 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

x – 1/x = 5

⇒ x3 – 1/x3 = 125 + 15

⇒ x3 – 1/x3 = 140

Now, according to the question

 (x⁶ - 5x³ - 1)/(x⁶ + 7x³ - 1)

⇒ (x3 – 1/x3 – 5)/(x3 – 1/x3 + 7) 

⇒ (140 – 5)/(140 + 7)

⇒ 135/147

⇒ 45/49

∴ The value of (x⁶ - 5x³ - 1)/(x⁶ + 7x³ - 1) is 45/49.

questions.question: A 240 m long train overtakes a man walking at 6 km/h, in the same direction, in 9 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take to pass a 372 m long tunnel with the same speed?
questions.solution:

The length of the train = 240 m

The speed of the man = 6 km/h

Time = 9 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of train be x m/sec

Speed of the man = 6 km/h = 6 × 5/18 = 5/3 m/sec

According to the question

240 = (x – 5/3 ) × 9

⇒ 80 = (3x – 5)

⇒ 85 = 3x

⇒ x = 85/3 m/sec

Now,

Distance = Total distance covered by train and Tunnel = (240 + 372) m

⇒ 612 m

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ [612/ (85/3)]

⇒ 21.6 sec

**∴ Time taken to pass the long tunnel with a same speed is 21.6**

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. Diagonals BD and AC intersect each other at E. If ∠BEC = 138° and ∠ECD = 35°, then what is the measure of ∠BAC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠BEC = 138° and ∠ECD = 35° 

**Concept used:**

In cyclic quadrilateral angles on the same arc are always same

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b35a9c0002af74141ef76ee1afc8a7e5187582fa4c5d75c216440abd9a50ee64.png] **

∠BEC and ∠CED are on the same straight lines 

∠BEC =138°

∠CED = 180° – 138° 

⇒ ∠CED = 42° 

In ΔCDE, ∠CED = 42° and ∠DCE = 35°

∠CDE = 180° - (42° + 35°)

∠CDE = 103° 

 ∠BAC and ∠BDC are on the same arc BC

We know that In cyclic quadrilateral angles on the same arc are always same.

∠BAC = 103°

**∴ The measure of ∠BAC is 103° **
